engine.text: Its own, in Swift (WalletCore), in the same repository as the app: keys, PSBTs, scripts, descriptors, compact-filter sync and peer networking

chain_data.text: BIP157/158 compact block filters from Bitcoin peers found through a signed peer list (census.winnowwallet.com) and DNS seeds; Advanced mode lets you add your own peers

third_party.text: Nobody for the everyday wallet; shared accounts need the other co-owners' keys, and there is no co-signing server

distribution.text: App Store; pre-release builds on TestFlight

libraries.text: swift-secp256k1 0.23.2 (Bitcoin Core's libsecp256k1), the only third-party dependency

prebuilt.text: None in the repository; the app links the swift-secp256k1 package that SwiftPM fetches
